Class Ray

java.lang.Object
primitives.Ray
public final class Ray extends Object
Class Ray represents a semi-line in 3D space.

      public Ray(Point origin, Vector direction, Vector normal)
      Constructor that shifts the ray origin by DELTA along the normal to avoid self-intersection.
      Parameters:
      origin - the original starting point
      direction - the direction of the ray

    • getPoint

      public Point getPoint(double t)
      Calculates a point on the ray's line at a given distance from the ray's origin. Uses the formula: P = P0 + t * v
      Parameters:
      t - the distance from the ray's origin
      Returns:
      the calculated point

    • findClosestIntersection

      public Intersectable.Intersection findClosestIntersection(List<Intersectable.Intersection> intersections)
      Finds the closest intersection to the ray's origin from a given list of intersections.
      Parameters:
      intersections - list of intersections to check
      Returns:
      the closest intersection, or null if the list is null or empty

    • findClosestPoint

      public Point findClosestPoint(List<Point> points)
      Finds the closest point to the ray's origin from a given list of points. Uses findClosestIntersection to maintain DRY principle.
      Parameters:
      points - list of points to check
      Returns:
      the closest point, or null if the list is null or empty
